name: Cascade-Correlation
summary: Starts with no hidden units, trains candidate units to correlate with residual error, adds the best candidate when residual-correlation search finds a useful feature, freezes its input weights, and repeats.

name: Dynamic Node Construction
summary: Expands a backpropagation network by adding hidden nodes during training when additional capacity is needed; the exact post-insertion stabilization rule remains a human-review question in the current draft.

name: Recurrent Cascade-Correlation
summary: Extends the cascade-correlation growth pattern into recurrent sequence-learning settings, while the reviewed 1995 analysis cautions that freezing or growth alone does not remove topology-imposed representational limits.

name: Constructive fully recurrent growth
summary: A cautious family label for approaches that add neurons during recurrent-network training while trying to preserve a fully recurrent topology rather than inheriting the one-directional cascade constraint.

name: Constructive spiking taxonomy
summary: Uses the thesis-derived three-process lens—when structure changes, what changes, and how parameters are chosen—to compare construction, pruning, and merging in spiking and non-spiking systems.

name: Evolving spiking-network lineage
summary: A cautious active-bundle bridge for eSNN/STDC material: Schliebs2013 grounds the lineage and vocabulary of evolving spiking networks, Wysoski2010 provides a reviewed audiovisual application anchor, Kasabov2013 is now the dynamic eSNN/deSNN detail-review placeholder, and Wang2014 is the supervised adaptive-structure placeholder. Exact growth-rule claims for Kasabov2013, Wang2014, and Roy2017 remain pending close full-text or human review.

name: Simulation expansion and contraction
summary: Interprets construction and pruning as transfers between simulated and surrounding neuron/synapse sets, with biological-plausibility constraints on how much activity a structural change may disrupt.

name: STDP hidden-pattern learning
summary: A cautious bundle-level bridge for the promoted STDP reviews: STDP can grow synaptic selectivity for repeated temporal structure, competition can make a fixed pool of listeners differentiate, single-neuron learnability results bound what timing-dependent synapse tuning can supply, and biological/phenomenological STDP reviews constrain how simple timing-window stories should be interpreted. This is not recorded as a neuron-growth algorithm until a reviewed source verifies structural growth.
